# Scenario assertions

Assertions live under `goals.assertions`. Each is a yes-or-no check against the
events the agent recorded. Unless a section says otherwise, a check passes when at
least one recorded event matches it.

## Skill

`skill_id` is the skill folder name (`card_replace` for
`skills/card_replace/skill.md`), not the frontmatter `name:`.

| Key | Required | Optional |
|---|---|---|
| `skill_activated` | `skill_id` | — |
| `skill_completed` | `skill_id` | — |
| `skill_cancelled` | `skill_id` | `step_id` |
| `skill_interrupted` | `skill_id` | `step_id` |
| `skill_resumed` | `skill_id` | `step_id` |

`step_id` narrows the check to the step the skill was on. Omit it unless you know
the recorded value: `autonomous` while the skill ran prose, or the ordered-block
step id. `skill_activated` and `skill_completed` reject it. An ordered-block event
never satisfies a skill check, and the other way around.

## Ordered block

`block_id` is the id written in the skill (`main`, `submit`); `skill_id` is the
skill that owns the block.

| Key | Required | Optional |
|---|---|---|
| `ordered_block_entered` | `skill_id`, `block_id` | — |
| `ordered_block_completed` | `skill_id`, `block_id` | `step_id` |
| `ordered_block_cancelled` | `skill_id`, `block_id` | `step_id` |
| `ordered_block_interrupted` | `skill_id`, `block_id` | `step_id` |
| `ordered_block_resumed` | `skill_id`, `block_id` | `step_id` |

## Memory

`name` is the key as the tracker stores it, scope and field joined with a dot:
`card_replace.replacement_reason`, `project.customer_authenticated`,
`system.channel`. A `session.` prefix never matches. Each key takes a list of
entries, and every entry must pass.

| Key | `name` | `value` |
|---|---|---|
| `memory_was_set` | Required | Optional. Without it, any write passes; with it, the written value must equal it exactly. |
| `memory_was_not_set` | Required | Optional. Without it, the check fails if the key was written at all; with it, it fails only if the last write was that value. |
| `memory_was_cleared` | Required | Not allowed. |

Values compare by type (`true` is not `"true"`, `5` is not `"5"`). Objects match in
any key order; lists only in the same order. `null` is not accepted. A key written
and later cleared passes `memory_was_set` and `memory_was_cleared`, and fails
`memory_was_not_set`.

## Tools

### `tool_executed`

| Field | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `tool_name` | Yes | |
| `source` | Yes | `local` or `mcp`. A local run never matches an MCP run of the same name. |
| `mcp_server` | When `source` is `mcp` | Not allowed for `local`; never inferred from the tool name. |
| `skill_id` | No | The run must have been made on behalf of that skill. |
| `arguments` | No | Each listed key must equal the called value; unlisted arguments are ignored. |
| `is_error` | No | `true` matches only failed runs, `false` only successful ones. |

### `tools_within_one_turn`

Passes when every listed call happened during the same user turn.

| Field | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `calls` | Yes | At least two `tool_executed` entries. |
| `allow_extra_calls` | Yes | `false` fails the turn if it holds any other counted tool run. |
| `ordered` | No | Defaults to `false`. `true` requires the listed order. |

Mantle's lifecycle tools (`complete`, `set_fields`, `listen`, `hangup`) are not
counted here; `search_knowledge` and `cannot_help` are. A standalone
`tool_executed` check still sees all of them.

```yaml
- tools_within_one_turn:
    ordered: true
    allow_extra_calls: false
    calls:
      - tool_executed:
          tool_name: check_card_status
          source: local
      - tool_executed:
          tool_name: place_replacement_order
          source: local
```

## Agent messages

`bot_uttered` passes when at least one agent message matches; `bot_did_not_utter`
passes when none does. Set at least one of:

| Field | Matches |
|---|---|
| `utter_name` | The response name the message was rendered from |
| `text_matches` | A regular expression searched anywhere in the message text |
| `buttons` | A list of `title` and optional `payload` the message carried |

## Sequencing

`sequencing` takes a list of checks and passes when each matches an event after the
one the previous check matched. Other events may sit in between.

- `memory_was_set` and `memory_was_cleared` take the key as a string, not a list,
  and cannot carry a `value`.
- Skill, ordered-block, and `tool_executed` checks keep their object shape; repeat
  `tool_name` and `source`.
- `memory_was_not_set` and `tools_within_one_turn` are not allowed.
